title: Design Studio Selections Package Schedule: Eligible Collections, Upgrade Fees and Downgrades
content:
The six Design Studio Selections packages are ranked from Studio Essentials (rank 1) to Studio Atelier (rank 6). Each package is open only to purchase agreements written in the collections listed against it, carries its own fee for moving into it from a lower-ranked package, and either permits or does not permit a move from it to a lower-ranked package.

| Package | Rank | Collections whose agreements may choose it | Fee for moving into it from a lower package (USD) | Move from it to a lower package permitted |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Essentials | 1 | Pathway Collection, Meadow Collection | 0.00 | Yes |
| Studio Classic | 2 | Pathway Collection, Meadow Collection, Heritage Collection | 0.00 | Yes |
| Studio Select | 3 | Meadow Collection, Heritage Collection, Crestview Collection | 250.00 | Yes |
| Studio Designer | 4 | Heritage Collection, Crestview Collection, Summit Collection | 250.00 | Yes |
| Studio Signature | 5 | Crestview Collection, Summit Collection, Reserve Collection | 500.00 | No |
| Studio Atelier | 6 | Summit Collection, Reserve Collection | 500.00 | No |

**Reading the schedule**

- The upgrade fee is the fee of the package being moved *into*, and it is booked on the file as an option line.
- Whether a move down is open is read from the package the file is *currently* in.

**The schedule read by collection** (an equivalent arrangement of the same rows)

| Collection | Packages open to it |
|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | Studio Essentials, Studio Classic |
| Meadow Collection | Studio Essentials, Studio Classic, Studio Select |
| Heritage Collection | Studio Classic, Studio Select, Studio Designer |
| Crestview Collection | Studio Select, Studio Designer, Studio Signature |
| Summit Collection | Studio Designer, Studio Signature, Studio Atelier |
| Reserve Collection | Studio Signature, Studio Atelier |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a file in Studio Classic on a Heritage Collection agreement that moves up to Studio Designer carries the Studio Designer fee of 250.00; a file in Studio Signature cannot be moved down to Studio Designer, because Studio Signature does not permit a move to a lower package.
